def main():
    import sys
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.split()
        length = int(parts[0])
        values = list(map(int, parts[1:]))
        values.sort()
        print(values[length // 2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
